tokens.name: surface-window
tokens.usage: Window ground behind every pane; the top bar and page bar.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Browser, Inspector and other pane bodies.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Libraries sidebar and the header strip above pane content.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets and Inspector sections.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, fields, segmented control track.

tokens.name: surface-control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of surface-control.

tokens.name: surface-timeline
tokens.usage: Timeline lanes ground.

tokens.name: surface-viewer
tokens.usage: Viewer surround. Dark in both themes so footage is judged on neutral black.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes, rows and sections (1px).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of fields, segmented tracks and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata and inactive tabs on surface-window, surface-panel, surface-sidebar and surface-raised. Not on surface-control in dark (4.4:1).

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels and ruler ticks only, never essential text (3:1 class).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, selected icons, focus ring and the active page underline; as text on surface-window, surface-panel and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button, active pill tab and switch track; carries on-accent text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows and selected clips' wash behind ink text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill, danger-fill and role strips.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring, 2px gap in the ground colour. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive states (render finished, in sync); as text on surface-window, surface-panel and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention states (missing proxy, dropped frames); as text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive labels; as text on the surfaces.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill, carries on-accent.

tokens.name: success-fill
tokens.usage: Positive badges and fills (position offset, render done); carries on-accent.

tokens.name: playhead
tokens.usage: Playhead line and handle, record indicators.

tokens.name: role-video
tokens.usage: Video clip body and filmstrip wash.

tokens.name: role-video-strip
tokens.usage: Video clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: role-titles
tokens.usage: Title and generator clip body.

tokens.name: role-titles-strip
tokens.usage: Title clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: role-music
tokens.usage: Music and audio clip body; waveform is ink at 55% over it.

tokens.name: role-music-strip
tokens.usage: Music clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: role-effects
tokens.usage: Effects and sound effects clip body.

tokens.name: role-effects-strip
tokens.usage: Effects clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: role-stills
tokens.usage: Image and slideshow clip body; an alias of role-effects so stills stay apart from video.

tokens.name: role-stills-strip
tokens.usage: Image and slideshow clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: role-composition
tokens.usage: Compositions, mixes and multicam markers; an alias of role-titles.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming behind overlays and drop previews.

tokens.name: role-voiceover
tokens.usage: Voiceover and dialogue clip body.

tokens.name: role-voiceover-strip
tokens.usage: Voiceover clip name strip; on-accent text.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Wash under transparent controls on hover: toolbar buttons, tabs, menu bar items.

tokens.name: fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Wash under transparent controls while pressed.

tokens.name: fill-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of slider tracks and progress bars.

tokens.name: fill-thumb
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thumb at rest.

tokens.name: fill-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thumb on hover and drag.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: macOS sizes. Body is 13px; everything else is a step on the same scale.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Pane tabs, clip names, track labels, help text.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Default UI text: lists, fields, menus, Inspector rows.

styles.name: text-body-strong
styles.usage: Inspector section titles, selected list rows, button labels.

styles.name: text-headline
styles.usage: Pane titles in empty states and sheets.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Rare. Welcome screen, export sheet headers, empty states.

styles.name: text-title2
styles.usage: Project name in the welcome screen and render summary.

groups.name: Timecode
groups.note: Tabular digits everywhere numbers line up.

styles.name: text-timecode
styles.usage: Monitor and timeline timecode, numeric fields.

styles.name: text-timecode-large
styles.usage: Viewer timecode display above the transport.

spacing.note: Exponential: every step doubles. Pick by hierarchy, not by eye.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a segmented control's segments, icon and badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls: icon to label, toolbar button to button.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related controls; control padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a pane; Inspector section padding; pane inner margin.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections of a sheet or dialog; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Welcome screen and sheet outer margins.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on the welcome screen only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, timeline clip name strip corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline clips, small buttons, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popovers, Inspector sections, cards in the browser.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheets and floating windows.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pill tabs, switches, sliders, round transport buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Raised controls: secondary buttons, the selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheets and floating panes.

size.note: Fixed heights so controls line up across panes.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, pill tabs, compact fields.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons, fields, segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary sheet actions, transport play button.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside fields and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in toolbars and lists.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Page bar and transport icons.

tokens.name: lane-video
tokens.usage: Default video lane height: name strip plus filmstrip.

tokens.name: lane-audio
tokens.usage: Default audio lane height.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scroll bar thickness; the thumb is inset 2px.

tokens.name: indicator
tokens.usage: Check boxes, radio buttons and tab close buttons.

tokens.name: slider-thumb
tokens.usage: Slider and switch thumb diameter.

tokens.name: slider-track
tokens.usage: Slider track thickness.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and muted tracks.

tokens.name: opacity-waveform
tokens.usage: Waveform ink over a clip body.
